name: session.focus_next_window
description: Make the next window the active window.

wrap.description: Whether to go from the last window back to the first. Defaults to false.

revision.description: The session's revision after this call. It is unchanged if the call changed nothing that session.view shows, unless the method's notes say otherwise.

validation_notes: The window order is the order of `windows` in `session.view`.
Each window keeps its own focused block, which then receives typing.
If there's no next window, nothing changes and the call still succeeds.
If the session doesn't exist, the call fails with `session_not_found`. If the session has no windows, it fails with `conflict`.
